eventMetadata.context_description: Amanda Anisimova, the world No. 6 and sixth seed, faces Julia Grabher in the second round at Roland Garros on red clay. Anisimova returns from an extended left-wrist injury layoff that caused multiple withdrawals earlier in 2026, limiting her recent match play while still carrying strong prior results on the surface and in Grand Slams. Grabher, ranked No. 121 with an 8-14 record this season, advanced past the first round but has shown inconsistent form across clay events. The matchup pits Anisimova’s superior ranking, serve power, and experience against Grabher’s home-soil comfort on clay and potential to extend rallies. Weather and any lingering effects from Anisimova’s injury represent the main variables heading into the contest.
